name: Sun-Bleached Ankh Scepter
description: A tall ceremonial scepter fashioned from carved red sandstone and wrapped with sun-bleached papyrus cordage. Its contours echo O'Keeffe's stark desert bone shapes.
interactiveProperties: When placed upon the Horizon Pedestal, it channels direct sunlight to unlock the Chamber of the Sun.
basedOn: Egyptian iconography of eternal life rendered through Georgia O'Keeffe's monumental, sun-baked desert bone aesthetic.

name: Papyrus Scroll of the Horizon
description: An ancient papyrus manuscript adorned with magnified, sweeping red-and-gold pigment lines representing the daily arc of Ra across the desert vault.
interactiveProperties: Can be deciphered at a scholar's desk to reveal the hidden star alignment sequence for the Tomb of the Astronomy Priests.
basedOn: Ancient Egyptian funerary scrolls synthesized with O'Keeffe's fluid, large-scale sky gradient compositions.

name: O'Keeffe Sun-Dappled Sunken Altar
description: A massive, sculpted sandstone basin featuring smooth organic curves that capture shifting shadows as the desert sun moves overhead.
interactiveProperties: Players can pour sacred desert water into the basin to trigger a light reflection puzzle that activates tomb door mechanisms.
basedOn: O'Keeffe's architectural landforms and desert canyon geometry fused with ancient Egyptian offering tables.

name: Sarcophagus Scale Puzzle Lock
description: An intricate stone lock mechanism embedded in tomb entrances, carved with oversized organic lotus blossoms and stylized scarabs.
interactiveProperties: Players rotate concentric stone rings to align sunburst patterns and open sealed burial vaults.
basedOn: Ancient Egyptian tomb locks stylized with O'Keeffe's magnified floral and desert landscape contours.

name: Monolithic Red Sandstone Throne
description: A high-backed ceremonial seat carved from a single block of desert sandstone, smoothed along organic lines resembling wind-carved desert cliffs.
interactiveProperties: Provides a rested status effect (+15% stamina regeneration) when sat upon by the player or Inn guests.
basedOn: Pharaonic royal thrones reinterpreted with O'Keeffe's stark Southwest desert canyon sculpture style.

name: Magnified Lotus Column Pillar
description: A towering structural column whose capital flowers outward into sweeping, simplified lotus petals painted in soft desert tones.
interactiveProperties: Serves as a structural support in building layouts and radiates ambient warmth to nearby decorative plants.
basedOn: Karnak temple lotus columns simplified into O'Keeffe's iconic magnified floral forms.

name: Gilded Papyrus Reed Stylus
description: A precision writing tool crafted from rigid papyrus stalk reinforced with beaten copper and tipped with polished desert glass.
interactiveProperties: Used to scribe hieroglyphic rubbings from ancient stelae and craft specialized cartouche recipes.
basedOn: Ancient Egyptian scribe instruments refined for digital archive cataloging in the Geode Inn.

name: Desert Glass Scarab Relic
description: A radiant scarab amulet carved from translucent silica desert glass formed by ancient meteorite impacts in the Libyan desert.
interactiveProperties: Can be displayed on velvet pedestals inside the Inn to increase room culture rating by 120 points.
basedOn: Tutankhamun's meteoritic desert glass pectoral amulets matched with O'Keeffe's luminous desert light study.

name: Monet's Olive-Crown Dial
description: A bronze solar dial surrounded by a wreath of impressionistic bronze and silver olive leaves that catch and refract dappled sunlight.
interactiveProperties: Aligning the shadow at solar noon unlocks the lost philosophical discourse of the Academy.
basedOn: Greek olive wreaths and sun dials rendered in Monet's shimmering, dappled garden lighting style.

name: Scroll of the Lyceum's Lost Theorem
description: A preserved parchment roll bound with woven silk thread, containing Aristotle's lost commentary on natural harmony and geometry.
interactiveProperties: Delivered to the Inn's Scholar NPC to complete the 'Architecture of Reason' questline.
basedOn: Classical Greek philosophical manuscripts and Monet's thematic focus on harmony and perception.

name: Impressionist Marble Water Basin
description: A shallow basin carved from white Parian marble, filled with water reflecting soft impressionist brushstroke ripples of sky and olive branches.
interactiveProperties: Players can float water lilies in the basin or gaze into it to reveal hidden quest clues in the reflections.
basedOn: Classical Greek nymph fountains merged directly with Monet's iconic water lily and reflection paintings.

name: Dappled Light Bronze Armillary Sphere
description: An astronomical instrument of interlinking bronze rings set upon a fluted marble pedestal, casting delicate dappled shadows.
interactiveProperties: Players can spin the celestial rings to align constellations and project starry light patterns onto room walls.
basedOn: Hellenistic astronomical instruments rendered through Monet's interest in light diffusion and atmospheric haze.

name: Sunlit Olive Wood Philosopher Bench
description: A spacious outdoor bench carved from seasoned olive wood with soft curved backrests designed for long philosophical debates.
interactiveProperties: Seats up to three avatars simultaneously and boosts intellectual crafting success rate by 10%.
basedOn: Agora debate benches from classical Athens softened by Monet's plein-air outdoor furniture aesthetics.

name: Fluted Parian Marble Pedestal
description: An elegant marble column section with delicate fluting that reflects ambient light in soft pastel hues.
interactiveProperties: Acts as a display platform for artifacts, statues, or urns, increasing nearby item beauty score.
basedOn: Doric and Ionic classical columns bathed in Monet's soft impressionistic Mediterranean morning light.

name: Bronze Caliper of Golden Ratios
description: A precise measuring tool crafted from cast bronze and silver rivets, used by ancient architects to calculate divine proportions.
interactiveProperties: Equipped while building structures to unlock perfect golden ratio blueprint snapping and bonus stability.
basedOn: Hellenistic mathematical instruments and Monet's structural canvas compositions.

name: Petrified Olive Leaf Pendant
description: An ancient olive leaf preserved in clear calcite matrix, hung on a fine bronze wire loop.
interactiveProperties: Can be stored in the archive collection cabinet to unlock the 'Athena's Blessing' lore entry.
basedOn: Sacred olive groves of Athens and Monet's shimmering foliage textures.

name: Cuneiform Tablet of the Deluge
description: A heavy baked clay tablet carved with sharp cuneiform script and bordered by dramatic Hokusai-style swirling wave engravings.
interactiveProperties: Translating the tablet at the Scribe's Desk reveals the location of the Great Marsh Ziggurat.
basedOn: The Epic of Gilgamesh Flood Tablet combined with Hokusai's iconic Great Wave printmaking aesthetic.

name: Golden Bull Head of Ur
description: A majestic lyre lyre-ornament depicting a sacred bull with a lapis lazuli beard and sweeping horns rendered in dynamic woodblock-style curves.
interactiveProperties: Mounted onto the Royal Lyre of Ur to restore ancient Mesopotamian musical acoustics in the Inn.
basedOn: The Royal Tombs of Ur lyre ornaments stylized with Hokusai's expressive animal silhouettes.

name: Bitumen-Sealed Reed Sluice Gate
description: A heavy marsh floodgate woven from dense river reeds and caulked with dark water-resistant bitumen, featuring stylized wave crests.
interactiveProperties: Players can raise or lower the gate handle to control water flow in the Inn's irrigation canals.
basedOn: Ancient Sumerian canal management infrastructure drawn with Hokusai's woodblock print outline vigor.

name: Hokusai Crested Wave Clay Stamp Wheel
description: A cylindrical terracotta seal mounted on a wooden spindle, designed to roll intricate wave and ziggurat patterns onto soft clay bricks.
interactiveProperties: Interacting with raw mudbrick stacks stamps them with ornamental wave crests prior to kiln firing.
basedOn: Mesopotamian cylinder seals crossed with Hokusai's thirty-six views wave motifs.

name: Glazed Cobalt Mudbrick Table
description: A sturdy low table constructed from baked mudbricks glazed in vibrant lapis blue, reminiscent of the Ishtar Gate.
interactiveProperties: Provides surface storage for up to four small items and grants an ambiance bonus to nearby dining areas.
basedOn: Babylonian glazed architectural brickwork rendered in Hokusai's intense Prussian blue pigment palette.

name: Marsh-Reed Braided Screen Bed
description: A elevated sleeping couch constructed from bound marsh reeds and bitumen-coated cedar legs, topped with woven linen mats.
interactiveProperties: Allows avatars to rest and skip night hours in the game cycle.
basedOn: Sumerian marsh dweller furniture (Madan architecture) with Hokusai's graphic textile patterns.

name: Bronze Reed Cuneiform Stylus
description: A bevel-tipped stylus forged from bronze with a carved reed handle, ideal for making crisp wedge marks in soft clay.
interactiveProperties: Used to write custom archival notes on wet clay tablets or craft tablet recipes.
basedOn: Traditional Mesopotamian scribal instruments.

name: Lapis Lazuli Cylinder Seal
description: A small carved cylinder of deep blue lapis lazuli engraved with miniature scenes of gods taming roaring wave monsters.
interactiveProperties: Can be stamped onto wax or clay in the catalog ledger to verify rare document authenticity.
basedOn: Sumerian and Akkadian cylinder seals showcasing mythic heroism and Hokusai's dynamic monster lines.

name: Grail Maiden's Enameled Reliquary
description: An opulent casket of chiseled silver and dark English oak, encrusted with ruby enamels depicting the vision of the Holy Grail.
interactiveProperties: Placing the Chalice of Light inside activates the glowing stained-glass sanctuary doors.
basedOn: Arthurian grail mythology rendered in Gustave Moreau's jewel-encrusted Symbolist painterly detail.

name: Chivalric Vow Parchment Scroll
description: An illuminated oath scroll bound in purple velvet and sealed with gold leaf, inscribed with the code of the Round Table.
interactiveProperties: Used at the Great Hall Bench to knight companion NPCs and boost their loyalty stat.
basedOn: Arthurian chivalric romance manuscripts and Moreau's mysterious, dreamlike heraldic symbolism.

name: Jeweled Round Table Compass
description: A heavy table-mounted brass dial set into a starburst pattern of English oak and inlaid silver, pointing toward sacred quest sites.
interactiveProperties: Players turn the central needle to reveal quest markers for hidden relics across the world map.
basedOn: King Arthur's Round Table combined with Moreau's intricate, star-dusted decorative arts designs.

name: Enchanted Sword Stone Anvil
description: A massive block of carved granite bound with iron bands, bearing a glowing blade socket where Excalibur was once drawn.
interactiveProperties: Players can insert broken quest blades to forge or repair magical chivalric weaponry.
basedOn: The legend of the Sword in the Stone cast in Moreau's mystical, dramatic lighting.

name: Carved English Oak High Chair
description: A tall-backed hall chair hand-carved with elaborate heraldic beasts, vine motifs, and stained-glass inlay accents.
interactiveProperties: Grants a 'Ruler's Presence' buff to avatars sitting at the head of a banquet hall.
basedOn: Medieval knightly thrones embellished with Moreau's intricate Symbolist woodcarvings.

name: Stained-Glass Gothic Arch Display Frame
description: A grand stone arch holding vibrant stained-glass panels that cast mystical red, cobalt, and gold light patterns across the floor.
interactiveProperties: Filters room lighting into rich jewel tones and enhances the display value of adjacent collectibles.
basedOn: Gothic cathedral windows featured in Moreau's atmospheric religious and mythic canvases.

name: Moreau Damascened Iron Broadsword
description: A ceremonial longsword forged with intricate gold damascening along the fuller, depicting dreamlike dragons and lilies.
interactiveProperties: Can be used to clear dense enchanted brambles or displayed as a wall-mounted weapon.
basedOn: Chivalric ceremonial weaponry rendered with Moreau's dense gold ornament.

name: Gilded Grail Goblet Fragment
description: A preserved fragment of a beaten gold chalice inset with cabochon garnets and intricate filigree.
interactiveProperties: Increases overall Inn mysticism score when exhibited in the Reliquary Wing.
basedOn: The Holy Grail motif central to Moreau's late Symbolist masterpieces.

name: Khipu Knot-Record of the Sun King
description: An intricate system of knotted cotton and alpaca wool cords dyed in indigo and ochre, recording ancient mountain harvest lore.
interactiveProperties: Decoded by the Weaver NPC to unlock high-altitude agricultural terrace blueprints.
basedOn: Inca khipu record-keeping reimagined through Guo Xi's misty, rhythmic mountain compositions.

name: Golden Intihuatana Sun Tether
description: A sacred carved gold and andesite pillar designed to 'hitch the sun' at the solstice, shaped with soaring mountain contours.
interactiveProperties: When calibrated at noon, it summons solar light trails that reveal hidden mountain passes.
basedOn: The Intihuatana stone of Machu Picchu stylized with Guo Xi's towering vertical mountain perspectives.

name: Fitting-Stone Terrace Sluice Lever
description: A precision-carved stone mechanism fitted seamlessly without mortar, used to control water channels on steep agricultural terraces.
interactiveProperties: Players pull the stone lever to irrigate terrace garden beds, doubling crop yield speed.
basedOn: Inca mortarless masonry and hydraulic engineering framed by Guo Xi's landscape harmony.

name: Mist-Resonating Panpipe Pillar
description: A vertical stone and alder-wood organ pipe structure that produces deep harmonic tones when mountain mists pass through it.
interactiveProperties: Playing specific musical notes on the pipes clears surrounding fog and triggers cloud-bridge paths.
basedOn: Andean panpipes (siku) integrated into Guo Xi's ethereal mist-and-mountain ink atmospheres.

name: Polished Andesite Throne Chair
description: A seat carved directly from volcanic stone with twelve-angled joint motifs and comfortable woven alpaca padding.
interactiveProperties: Offers sturdy seating for avatars and provides immunity to cold weather effects nearby.
basedOn: Inca royal stone thrones and Guo Xi's monumental mountain rock textures.

name: Andean Alder Carved Storage Chest
description: A heavy wooden chest made from native Andean alder wood, decorated with geometric Inca key (tocapu) patterns and gold latches.
interactiveProperties: Provides 24 slots of item storage for seeds, ores, and textile materials.
basedOn: Inca wooden qero vessels and furniture with Guo Xi's organic wood grain brushwork.

name: Inca Bronze Chappi Adze
description: A durable cutting tool with a heavy bronze blade lashed to a curved Andean alder handle using leather thongs.
interactiveProperties: Used for harvesting mountain alder timber and shaping precision stone blocks.
basedOn: Traditional Inca metalworking and stonemason tools.

name: Guo Xi Mist-Flecked Gold Mask
description: A ceremonial golden burial mask featuring repoussé mountain spirits surrounded by swirling ink-like cloud tendrils.
interactiveProperties: Can be mounted on gallery walls to boost room elegance score by 150 points.
basedOn: Sican and Inca funerary masks fused with Guo Xi's northern Song landscape mist aesthetics.

name: Imperial Silk Calligraphy Scroll of Honor
description: A long silk wall scroll featuring bold, sweeping ink-wash brushwork depicting mountain bamboo and heroic verses of loyalty.
interactiveProperties: Hanging the scroll in the Main Hall unlocks the 'Path of the Warrior Scholar' quest.
basedOn: The Ballad of Mulan and classical Song Dynasty ink-wash calligraphy scrolls.
variants: Gold Leaf Ink on Crimson Silk

name: Jade Dragon Jadeite Seal
description: A square seal carved from translucent green jade, topped with a coiled dragon executed with fluid calligraphic curves.
interactiveProperties: Used to stamp official imperial pardons and open the Pavilion of Five Dragons.
basedOn: Chinese imperial jade seals (Xi) styled with expressive Mulan-era ink stroke silhouettes.

name: Ink-Wash Bamboo Wind Chime Fountain
description: A tranquil water feature crafted from hollow bamboo stalks and black river stone, producing gentle rhythmic clicks and splashing water.
interactiveProperties: Interacting with the fountain restores avatar focus and generates ambient relaxation soundscapes.
basedOn: Traditional East Asian garden water features rendered in fluid ink-wash animation.

name: Carved Lacquer Weiqi Game Board
description: A low wooden table coated in glossy cinnabar lacquer, inlaid with jade grid lines and featuring bowls of black and white stone pieces.
interactiveProperties: Two avatars can sit and play a full game of Go (Weiqi) to earn strategy perks.
basedOn: Classical scholar games depicted in Chinese monochrome paintings and court arts.

name: Cinnabar Lacquer Pagoda Cabinet
description: A multi-tiered storage cabinet shaped like a classic pagoda, coated in deep red lacquer with hand-painted gold bamboo motifs.
interactiveProperties: Holds up to 30 items and acts as a focal decor piece for oriental tea rooms.
basedOn: Ming and Qing Dynasty carved lacquerware furniture simplified into crisp ink-wash lines.

name: Slender Bamboo Screen Divider
description: A lightweight room screen composed of woven bamboo slats framed in dark stained timber, decorated with subtle ink pine prints.
interactiveProperties: Divides room spaces to create private alcoves while allowing ambient light to pass through.
basedOn: Traditional Chinese folding screens (Pingfeng) featuring brush-and-ink landscapes.

name: Scholar's Wolf-Hair Calligraphy Brush
description: A fine ink brush with a carved bamboo shaft and nickel-wrapped wolf hair bristles, ideal for expressive landscape painting.
interactiveProperties: Used to paint ink-wash murals on plain plaster walls inside the Inn.
basedOn: The Four Treasures of the Study in classical Chinese scholar culture.

name: Carved Dragon Jade Figurine
description: A pocket-sized statuette of a celestial dragon carved from mottled green jade, smooth to the touch.
interactiveProperties: Can be gifted to NPCs to significantly raise friendship levels.
basedOn: Chinese jade carving traditions celebrating luck, honor, and nature.

name: Runestone of the World Tree
description: A slab of grey granite carved with intricate insular knotwork serpents framing ancient Futhark runes illuminated in gold leaf.
interactiveProperties: Placing the stone into the Hearth Nexus unlocks the Yggdrasil realm branch on the world map.
basedOn: Norse runestones rendered with Book of Kells style manuscript interlacing and serpent zoomorphs.

name: Illuminated Longship Prow Ribbon
description: A carved pine longship prow dragonhead wrapped in illuminated vellum ribbons featuring knotwork monsters.
interactiveProperties: Attached to the Inn's harbor ship to enable passage through storm-wracked fjords.
basedOn: Oseberg ship dragon prows merged with insular illuminated manuscript motifs.

name: Bog-Iron Serpent Knotwork Anvil
description: A heavy blacksmith anvil smelted from bog iron ore, its sides deeply chiseled with interlacing Book of Kells beast knotwork.
interactiveProperties: Players use the anvil to forge runic tools and armored gear with enhanced durability.
basedOn: Viking Age bog iron metallurgy decorated with insular manuscript animal knotwork.

name: Runestone Sunstone Compass Dial
description: A stone disk set with a translucent Icelandic spar crystal and framed by Celtic-Norse interlaced metal borders.
interactiveProperties: Rotating the stone aligns sunbeams through overcast skies to reveal hidden treasure coordinates.
basedOn: Norse sunstone navigation devices embellished with Book of Kells illuminated borders.

name: Kells Interlaced Pine Feast Bench
description: A long communal hall bench crafted from sturdy pine, decorated along the seat edges with carved ribbon-beast knotwork.
interactiveProperties: Seats up to six avatars for mead hall feasting, granting a 'Skaldic Cheer' stamina buff.
basedOn: Norse mead hall furniture decorated with Book of Kells illuminated interlace carvings.

name: Carved Birch Shield Display Rack
description: A wall-mounted rack constructed from birch timber and bog iron fittings, built to hold up to four round shields.
interactiveProperties: Displays shields vertically while giving a defense boost to the surrounding room.
basedOn: Longhouse armory racks decorated with insular interlacing strapwork.

name: Insular Bog Iron Woodcarving Gouge
description: A sharp chisel tool forged from bog iron with an ergonomically shaped birch wood handle.
interactiveProperties: Used to carve complex knotwork patterns onto wooden furniture and boat beams.
basedOn: Viking woodworking tools and manuscript illustration stylistics.

name: Polished Baltic Amber Beast Amulet
description: A glowing chunk of golden Baltic amber carved into a coiled beast figure with interlaced limbs.
interactiveProperties: Glows softly in dark rooms and grants nearby plants faster growth rates.
basedOn: Viking amber trade goods and Celtic/Norse animal art styles.

name: Icon of the Firebird Feather
description: A sacred panel painting framed in carved birch, depicting a glowing Firebird feather against Roerich's signature ultramarine mountains.
interactiveProperties: Placed in the Hearth Shrine to complete the 'Light of Tsarevich' quest and banish dark frost.
basedOn: Slavic folklore of the Firebird rendered in Nicholas Roerich's luminous, spiritual color palette.

name: Amber Rosary of the Sacred Forest
description: A strand of thirty-three polished Baltic amber beads linked by silver wire, radiating a warm pine resin scent.
interactiveProperties: Used to bless the forest shrine and appease local Leshy nature spirits.
basedOn: Orthodox prayer beads combined with Roerich's veneration of sacred mountain forests.

name: Orthodox Bell Chime Console
description: A miniature bronze bell tower frame resting on birch beams, tuned to ring deep resonant spiritual chords.
interactiveProperties: Players can ring the bells in sequence to play traditional Slavic folk melodies and summon songbirds.
basedOn: Slavic Orthodox church bell ringing (Zvon) and Roerich's architectural paintings of ancient Pskov.

name: Gilded Birch Sacred Hearth Shrine
description: A wooden corner altar (Krasny Ugol) carved from white birch, featuring gold foil trim and candle holders.
interactiveProperties: Players can light beeswax candles at the shrine to grant the Inn guests a feeling of warmth and peace.
basedOn: The 'Beautiful Corner' tradition in Slavic homes framed by Roerich's vivid, reverent art style.

name: Roerich Cobalt Painted Birch Bench
description: A sturdy wooden bench painted in deep cobalt blue and ochre folk motifs, inspired by ancient Northern Russian timber work.
interactiveProperties: Provides comfortable seating for two and enhances room color harmony rating.
basedOn: Russian folk furniture depicted in Roerich's stage sets for Le Sacre du Printemps.

name: Carved Lime-Wood Iconostasis Screen
description: A tall wooden screen filled with delicate floral fretwork and arches designed to hold sacred icons and artwork.
interactiveProperties: Serves as a partition wall that displays up to three paintings or collectible icons.
basedOn: Orthodox iconostasis screens painted with Roerich's bold architectural geometry.

name: Repoussé Brass Birch-Bark Carving Knife
description: A short, sharp carving knife with a repoussé brass ferrule and a layered birch-bark handle that provides a firm grip.
interactiveProperties: Used to craft birch-bark containers (tuyas) and intricate wooden folk toys.
basedOn: Traditional Northern Russian artisan woodworking tools.

name: Raw Baltic Amber Sun-Stone Gem
description: An uncut piece of raw golden amber containing ancient pine needle inclusions, glowing when held up to sunlight.
interactiveProperties: Can be refined into varnish or displayed in gem cabinets for high prestige score.
basedOn: Baltic amber trade routes and Roerich's glowing mountain color harmonies.

name: Copper Plate Charter of the Monsoon Route
description: An engraved copper plate inscribed with poetic maritime routes and star charts used by ancient spice traders.
interactiveProperties: Examined on the Map Table to open the Indian Ocean spice route trade missions.
basedOn: Ancient Indian copper plate grants (Tamrapatra) combined with Tagore's poetic travel memoirs.

name: Sandalwood Veena of Poetic Verses
description: A musical stringed instrument carved from fragrant red sandalwood, featuring gourd resonators etched with fluid Tagore ink motifs.
interactiveProperties: Playing the Veena in the Courtyard unlocks the 'Song of the Evening Raga' quest event.
basedOn: Classical Indian musical traditions and Rabindranath Tagore's Rabindra Sangeet composition heritage.

name: Tagore Brass Incense Burner Fountain
description: A tiered brass burner that releases gentle sandalwood incense smoke that flows downward like liquid water over copper steps.
interactiveProperties: Players can ignite various spice incense sticks to change the fragrance and ambient mood of the room.
basedOn: Temple incense rituals and Tagore's fluid, rhythmically curved ink paintings.

name: Temple Lotus Oil Lamp Turret
description: A multi-tiered brass lamp tower (Deepastambha) adorned with lotus petal wicks that cast warm flickering light.
interactiveProperties: Lighting all oil lamp tiers illuminates dark courtyard areas and attracts fireflies at night.
basedOn: South Indian temple oil lamps combined with Tagore's poetic imagery of light and devotion.

name: Carved Teakwood Temple Daybed
description: A sprawling daybed carved from solid teak timber, outfitted with silk bolster cushions and intricate floral lattice feet.
interactiveProperties: Allows avatars to lounge, granting rapid health and stamina recovery bonuses.
basedOn: Traditional Indian charpai and swing beds reinterpreted with Tagore's organic artistic elegance.

name: Lattice Sandalwood Jali Screen
description: An exquisitely carved sandalwood partition screen featuring complex geometric and floral ventilation patterns.
interactiveProperties: Fills nearby rooms with natural sandalwood aroma and casts intricate shadow patterns.
basedOn: Mughal and Rajput stone/wood jali screens praised in Tagore's architectural writings.

name: Engraved Copper Spice Grinder Mortar
description: A heavy copper mortar and pestle set etched with swirling vine patterns, used for crushing aromatic spices.
interactiveProperties: Used to process rare spices into dyes, remedies, and exotic tea recipes.
basedOn: Traditional Indian culinary and Ayurvedic processing tools.

name: Lotus-Engraved Copper Coin Relic
description: An ancient copper coin stamped with a blooming lotus and calligraphic Sanskrit script.
interactiveProperties: Can be placed in coin display trays to increase trade merchant discounts by 5%.
basedOn: Gupta and Chola Dynasty coinage integrated into Tagore's historical archives.

name: Will-o'-the-Wisp Lantern Vessel
description: A eerie jar fashioned from murky blown glass and cypress bark, containing a floating, glowing swamp wisp in dark crosshatched glass.
interactiveProperties: Carried through murky bayou fogs to ward off shadow creatures and illuminate hidden sunken paths.
basedOn: Don't Starve light sources and bayou spirit legends with sketchy hand-drawn dark lines.

name: Swamp Witch's Dried Spanish Moss Doll
description: A crude poppet bound from dried Spanish moss, twiggy cypress fingers, and bog iron wire, carrying eerie charm protections.
interactiveProperties: Given to the Swamp Trapper NPC to unlock secret bayou fishing holes.
basedOn: Southern swamp folklore and Don't Starve's dark, sketchy hand-crafted survival items.

name: Cypress Log Crocodile Trap
description: A heavy spring-loaded jaw trap constructed from jagged cypress timber, bog iron spikes, and woven reed ropes.
interactiveProperties: Players can set the trap in swamp waters to catch giant bayou gators or aggressive marsh beasts.
basedOn: Don't Starve wilderness trap mechanics rendered with gothic crosshatched timber textures.

name: Bog Iron Smokehouse Smoker
description: A tall, rickety outdoor smoker made from rusted bog iron plates and cypress wood slatted doors, venting hickory smoke.
interactiveProperties: Preserves raw meat and fish into jerky, extending item shelf life indefinitely.
basedOn: Don't Starve drying racks and food smoker survival structures with sketchy line aesthetics.

name: Stilt-Mounted Cypress Plank Table
description: A rustic dining table built on rough stilt legs to keep food above murky swamp floodwaters, draped with Spanish moss.
interactiveProperties: Serves as a sturdy surface for crafting hearty swamp stews and organizing tools.
basedOn: Bayou stilt cabin furniture styled with Don't Starve's angular, scratchy woodgrain strokes.

name: Spanish Moss Stuffed Rocking Chair
description: A creaky rocking chair fashioned from bent cypress knees and cushioned with dried Spanish moss and canvas.
interactiveProperties: Rocking in the chair slowly restores sanity/mental composure in dark environments.
basedOn: Southern porch rockers rendered through Don't Starve's eerie gothic hand-drawn art style.

name: Forged Bog Iron Swamp Machete
description: A heavy, jagged blade forged from crude bog iron with a comfortable wrapped cypress handle.
interactiveProperties: Clears dense Spanish moss, thick reeds, and overgrown vines to open hidden pathways.
basedOn: Don't Starve wilderness clearing tools with dark scratchy crosshatching.

name: Preserved Gator Tooth Amulet
description: A necklace of bleached alligator teeth strung on twisted swamp reed cord with a central bog iron charm.
interactiveProperties: Grants the wearer a +10% damage bonus against aquatic creatures.
basedOn: Swamp trophy crafts and Don't Starve monster drop amulets.

name: Swirling Sunflower Trellis
description: A high arched garden trellis wrapped in vibrant sunflowers that twist in expressive, thick-painted curves. The flowers seem to follow an invisible sun, glowing with golden warmth even indoors.
interactiveProperties: Climbing plants grow 25% faster when planted nearby. Players can sit beneath the arch to gain a 'Sunlight Warmth' buff (+10% crafting speed for botanical recipes).
basedOn: Van Gogh's Sunflowers series and organic iron lattice work

name: Starry Glasshouse Workbench
description: A heavy oak garden workbench with a cobalt glass inlay top that refracts light into swirling blue and yellow patterns across the studio floor.
interactiveProperties: Acts as a primary crafting station for seed mixtures and botanical pigments. Placing rare herbs on the glass reveals hidden optical traits.
basedOn: Van Gogh's Starry Night color palette and French artisan workbenches

name: Impasto Pigment Distiller
description: A heated copper distillation apparatus used to boil down garden blossoms into vibrant, oil-thick botanical pigments and fragrant tinctures.
interactiveProperties: Players insert garden blossoms and fuel (wood or peat) to distill 'Impasto Oils'. Interacting opens a mini-game to balance heat and color density.
basedOn: Van Gogh's thick oil paint mixing process and herbal alchemy

name: Swirling Cypress Sky Lantern
description: A tall cylindrical paper-and-canvas lantern framed in cypress wood, casting swirling impasto light patterns onto surrounding garden walls.
interactiveProperties: Can be toggled on or off to change garden lighting. Interacting with 'Rotate Prism' changes the cast shadows from golden daylight to starry cobalt.
basedOn: Van Gogh's iconic cypress silhouettes against swirling night skies

name: Vibrant Iris Seedpod
description: A rare, pulsing seedpod harvested from the deep garden beds. It radiates a deep violet light and hums with natural vital energy.
interactiveProperties: Quest item required by the Master Herbalist to restore the Starry Glasshouse. Cannot be consumed, but can be analyzed at the Translation Desk.
basedOn: Van Gogh's Irises and the herbalist quest line for lost hues

name: Wheatfield Sheaf of Abundance
description: A tightly bound sheaf of golden wheat harvested at peak summer solstice. Each grain shines with an unnatural metallic luster.
interactiveProperties: Delivered to the Common Room Hearthmaster to initiate the Festival of the Sun quest. Grants temporary harvest aura when carried in inventory.
basedOn: Van Gogh's Wheatfield series and harvest festival lore

name: Impasto Palette Knife
description: A flexible steel palette knife with a carved cypress handle, used to shape botanical resins, scrape rare lichen, and mix paint pigments.
interactiveProperties: Equippable tool used to scrape sap from garden trees without damaging the bark. Unlocks precision sculpting on clay and wax furniture.
basedOn: Van Gogh's heavy palette knife techniques

name: Starry Night Glass Marble
description: A smooth glass orb containing a miniature swirling vortex of blue cobalt paint and suspended gold flakes that shift when held.
interactiveProperties: Can be placed on display pedestals or traded with visiting collectors for rare seed packs. Inspecting displays a brief particle effect.
basedOn: Van Gogh's Starry Night swirl motifs

name: Cubist Fermentation Barrel
description: A wooden mead barrel constructed with deliberately offset, sharp angular staves. Despite its surreal shape, it ferments honey at an unmatched rate.
interactiveProperties: Stores up to 100 liters of aging mead. Interacting allows players to sample the brew and check fermentation age and alcohol percentage.
basedOn: Picasso's synthetic cubist sculptures and multi-perspective wooden forms

name: Multi-Perspective Tavern Bench
description: A tavern bench that appears to face three directions simultaneously. Sitting on it provides an unusually clear view of the entire room.
interactiveProperties: Seats up to 3 players at different geometric angles. Players seated here gain 'Tavern Camaraderie' (+5% charisma in dialogue).
basedOn: Picasso's cubist seating in Three Musicians

name: Fractured Glass Decanter Array
description: An array of sharp, geometric glass decanters mounted on a brass rack, allowing patrons to dispense multi-layered honey spirits.
interactiveProperties: Players can pull levers to blend different mead vintages. Correct geometric combinations yield rare infused cordials.
basedOn: Picasso's Glass and Bottle of Suze and cubist glasswork

name: Geometric Honeycomb Press
description: A heavy mechanical press featuring interlocking triangular plates used to extract raw honey and royal jelly from geometric comb slabs.
interactiveProperties: Insert raw honeycomb blocks and turn the crank to refine Pure Honey and Comb Wax. Turning too fast risks crushing the comb structure.
basedOn: Picasso's analytical cubism and mechanical bee structures

name: Fractured Queen's Royal Comb
description: A slab of honeycomb where every cell forms a perfect mathematical polygon. It smells intensely of wild thistles and fermented nectar.
interactiveProperties: Required by Master Brewer Picasso-vane to brew the legendary 'Aura Mead'. Cannot be eaten raw without triggering a quest prompt.
basedOn: Picasso's Cubist Queen motif and the Meadmaster's secret recipe

name: Dissonant Cellar Key
description: An irregular iron key whose bits and wards rearrange depending on the angle at which light strikes the metal surface.
interactiveProperties: Unlocks the Subterranean Aging Vault beneath the Meadery. Must be rotated 90 degrees in three dimensions during the lockpicking interface.
basedOn: Cubist key designs with shifting geometry

name: Asymmetrical Hydrometer
description: A specialized floating glass hydrometer with a multi-angled scale for measuring sugar content and alcohol proof in fermenting vats.
interactiveProperties: Equippable tool used on any vat or barrel to reveal exact sugar density, fermentation progress, and potential flavor notes.
basedOn: Cubist scientific instruments and precise brewing tools

name: Cubic Amber Mead Crystal
description: A perfectly square block of dark amber honey crystal formed after a century of evaporation in the deep tavern cellars.
interactiveProperties: Can be placed on display stands or gifted to the Meadmaster to unlock historical brewing lore notes.
basedOn: Picasso's cubist geometric solid representations

name: Firekeeper's Grand Carved Throne
description: A towering carved dark oak armchair cushioned in plush crimson velvet and reinforced with heavy iron scrollwork. It overlooks the entire Common Room.
interactiveProperties: Sitting in the throne grants the 'Hearthmaster's Authority' buff, causing nearby NPCs to treat you with high respect and grant lower vendor prices.
basedOn: The Firekeeper's chair at the heart of the Geode Inn

name: Communal Hearthstone Banquet Table
description: A long, wide stone table with a fire-warmed central slab. Built to hold endless platters of roasts, flagons of mead, and traveler maps.
interactiveProperties: Up to 6 players can sit together. Food placed on the center slab stays piping hot indefinitely due to internal thermal stone properties.
basedOn: The central communal tables near the great fire

name: The Eternal Hearth Fireplace
description: A massive floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace housing a pulsing Fire Crystal core that radiates steady amber warmth across the entire hub.
interactiveProperties: Players can stoke the fire with different wood logs (Oak, Pine, Crystal-Infused) to alter room lighting, music tempo, and resting buff potency.
basedOn: The primary architectural centerpiece of the Common Room

name: Amber Crystal Goblet Fountain
description: A tiered brass fountain holding amber glass goblets that fill continuously with spiced hearth-cider.
interactiveProperties: Players can take a goblet and trigger a 'Raise a Toast' interaction with other players, conferring a party-wide stamina regeneration buff.
basedOn: The Firekeeper's crystal goblet array and toast mechanics

name: Embossed Guest Ledger of the Inn
description: A massive, iron-clasped leather book containing centuries of traveler signatures, cryptic notes, and hidden floorplan sketches.
interactiveProperties: Required by the Innkeeper to verify the identity of forgotten heroes. Reading it reveals lore entries and unlocks historical quest logs.
basedOn: The historical register recording every guest who ever crossed the threshold

name: Firekeeper's Crest Signet Ring
description: A heavy iron ring set with a glowing amber stone carved in the shape of the Geode Inn's double-hearth crest.
interactiveProperties: Unlocks the heavy oak doors leading from the Common Room down into the Catacombs and Bone Room. Cannot be dropped.
basedOn: The Firekeeper's badge of office and security key

name: Carved Oak Hearth Tongs
description: Long, elegant iron tongs with smooth oak handles, designed to manipulate glowing embers without transferring heat to the wielder.
interactiveProperties: Equippable tool used to harvest 'Eternal Embers' directly from the Great Hearth or relocate burning fire crystals safely.
basedOn: The Firekeeper's essential fire maintenance tool

name: Prismatic Hearth Ember
description: A solidified stone ember that glows with a gentle orange-gold pulse, warm to the touch even when submerged in icy water.
interactiveProperties: Can be set in lanterns, placed on tables as personal hand-warmers, or displayed in trophy cabinets.
basedOn: Ember stones that retain heat and light indefinitely

name: Gilded Osteo-Lattice Altar
description: An exquisite altar formed from interlocking bleached bone arches draped in intricate geometric gold leaf mosaic patterns.
interactiveProperties: Functions as a ceremonial focus for osteo-synthesis crafting. Placing bone artifacts here cleanses them of dark corruption.
basedOn: O'Keeffe's skull and bone compositions wrapped in Gustav Klimt's shimmering gold leaf patterns

name: Opalescent Vertebrae Bench
description: A bench sculpted from massive fossilized whale vertebrae, smooth as porcelain, set with glittering opal mosaic tiles.
interactiveProperties: Provides seating for two. Sitting here grants 'Osteo Resilience' (+15 defense against physical crushed status effects).
basedOn: O'Keeffe's bone landscapes and Klimt's decorative jewel-tone mosaic patterns

name: Calcite Skull Resonator
description: A pristine stag skull mounted on dark basalt, its eye sockets filled with cluster crystals that hum when wind or sound passes through.
interactiveProperties: Players can strike the crystal antlers to produce musical tones. Solving tone puzzles unlocks hidden alcoves in the Bone Room.
basedOn: O'Keeffe's Ram's Head with Hollyhock and Klimt's golden acoustic patterns

name: Gilded Bone Loom
description: A tall vertical loom built from polished longbones and brass gears, used to weave fine golden thread with calcium silk.
interactiveProperties: Allows players to craft gilded textiles and bone-reinforced armor lining. Requires precise timing in a weaving rhythm mini-game.
basedOn: Klimt's textile motifs combined with skeletal structural framework

name: Bleached Ram's Horn of Solstice
description: A massive spiral ram's horn coated in delicate Klimt-style gold leaf scrollwork, ringing with a soft echo when held.
interactiveProperties: Required to open the Golden Bone Gate leading into the subterranean Deep Catacombs. Sounds a low trumpet call when used.
basedOn: O'Keeffe's iconic Ram's Head paintings

name: Fossilized Ammonite Prism
description: A perfectly preserved spiral ammonite fossil whose inner chambers have transformed into radiant prismatic calcite crystals.
interactiveProperties: Fits into the central altar of the Bone Room to align light beams onto hidden mural walls. Key item for the Archaeologist quest.
basedOn: Spiral shell geometry and Klimt's metallic organic patterns

name: Gold-Leaf Bone Stylus
description: A sharp ivory stylus tipped with hardened gold alloy, engineered for delicate rune engraving on bone and fossil surfaces.
interactiveProperties: Equippable tool that enables 'Bone Engraving' on raw fossil materials. Increases item quality when crafting osteo-furniture.
basedOn: Precision carving tools used in gilded osteo-artistry

name: Opalized Trilobite Cameo
description: A tiny prehistoric trilobite fossil that has completely opalized into a fiery display of blue, green, and gold iridescence.
interactiveProperties: Can be framed and hung on walls or traded to the Relic Collector for high-tier crafting recipes.
basedOn: Prehistoric fossils transformed into luxurious Klimt-style jewelry

name: Chiaroscuro Basalt Arch Chair
description: A massive throne carved from dark basalt, featuring sweeping gothic arches that throw deep, angular shadows across the stone floor.
interactiveProperties: Player can sit to gain 'Subterranean Focus' (+10% vision range in dark caves). The chair's surface feels cool and immovably solid.
basedOn: Gustave Doré's monumental dark architecture and dramatic shadows

name: Glow-Moss Lit Scholar's Desk
description: A heavy slate desk built directly into a cave niche, illuminated by a canopy of cultivated bioluminescent green moss.
interactiveProperties: Functions as a research desk for subterranean mapping. Items left on the desk are visible in total darkness due to moss luminescence.
basedOn: Doré's subterranean scholars and engraver studios

name: Abyssal Chasm Pulley Elevator
description: A heavy industrial cable system mounted over an abyssal drop, allowing players to lower themselves into lower cave tiers.
interactiveProperties: Interacting allows players to ride between upper Cave City and the Abyss floor. Players can operate the hand crank or lock the brake.
basedOn: Doré's monumental winches, bridge engineering, and subterranean chasms

name: Bioluminescent Mushroom Lantern Array
description: A cluster of large blue-glowing cap mushrooms housed inside a protective wrought iron cage to prevent spore escape.
interactiveProperties: Players can tap the cage to trigger a bright pulse of blue light that reveals hidden wall markings and frightens dark pests.
basedOn: Subterranean lighting in Doré's underground caverns

name: Engraved Basalt Waystone Map
description: A heavy stone slab etched with microscopic lines depicting the labyrinthine tunnels and hidden aqueducts of Cave City.
interactiveProperties: Delivered to the Cave Cartographer to reveal all fast-travel waypoints across the subterranean zone on the player's map.
basedOn: Doré's detailed steelplate engravings

name: Subterranean Chime Tuning Fork
description: A heavy two-pronged bronze fork that rings with a resonant low pitch capable of shattering acoustic granite locks.
interactiveProperties: Used at sealed granite doorways in Cave City. Interacting triggers a reverberation wave that breaks the stone seal.
basedOn: Acoustic stone-shattering mechanics in deep caverns

name: Engraver's Basalt Chisel Set
description: A roll of precision steel chisels designed to carve sharp, crosshatched grooves into hard volcanic rock.
interactiveProperties: Equippable tool used to harvest mineral veins cleanly and carve player custom runes onto stone walls and furniture.
basedOn: Doré's master engraving techniques transferred to stone carving

name: Deep-Cave Indigo Spore Globe
description: A sealed glass sphere containing living indigo spores that float endlessly in a nutrient gel, casting soft blue ripples.
interactiveProperties: Can be placed on tables as a permanent soft light source or gifted to the Botanist to unlock fungal recipes.
basedOn: Doré's ethereal subterranean light sources

name: Crosshatched Iron Plant Stand
description: A spindly multi-tiered iron plant stand rendered in sharp, crosshatched black metal, holding potting urns of venomous flora.
interactiveProperties: Holds up to 4 small potted poison plants. Plants placed here produce venom drops 20% faster.
basedOn: Edward Gorey's pen-and-ink crosshatched Victorian wrought iron designs

name: Velvet-Lined Apothecary Cabinet
description: A tall, narrow ebonized wood cabinet featuring dozens of tiny drawers labeled with cryptic Victorian latin poison names.
interactiveProperties: Provides 30 dedicated storage slots for toxins, seeds, and antidotes. Features a locked secret compartment behind the velvet back panel.
basedOn: Gorey's sinister Edwardian specimen displays and poison cupboards

name: Thorn-Vine Birdcage Greenhouse
description: A towering Victorian birdcage converted into a miniature greenhouse to contain a thrashing, carnivorous thorn-vine plant.
interactiveProperties: Players can feed insect specimens or meat to the thorn vine to harvest 'Razor-Thorn Resin'. Careful not to get bitten!
basedOn: Gorey's ominous aviaries and sinister greenhouse illustrations

name: Sinister Belladonna Tea Service
description: An exquisite black china teapot and cup set painted with delicate nightshade flowers and crosshatched vine motifs.
interactiveProperties: Players can brew 'Micro-Dosed Herbal Tea'. Drinking grants immune resistance to all poison traps for 15 minutes.
basedOn: Gorey's dark humor Victorian tea parties

name: Bottled Cobra Venom Flask
description: A triangular glass bottle filled with viscous green liquid, sealed with black wax and stamped with a skull emblem.
interactiveProperties: Delivered to the Master Apothecary to brew the Universal Antidote. Highly volatile if opened improperly.
basedOn: Gorey's alphabet of toxins and Edwardian apothecary lore

name: Edwardian Nightshade Journal
description: A sinister handwritten field guide containing detailed crosshatched illustrations of lethal flora and their exact antidote formulas.
interactiveProperties: Reading unlocks all Poison Garden plant recipes in the player's herbology codex. Key quest item for the Herbalist.
basedOn: Gorey's illustrated books and botanical field notes

name: Gravedigger's Pruning Shears
description: Heavy-duty steel shears with serrated inner jaws designed to snip thick, venomous thorn vines without causing sap splatter.
interactiveProperties: Equippable tool used to clear thorn-vine blockages in the Poison Garden and harvest rare plant cuttings safely.
basedOn: Gorey's sharp gothic tools

name: Crosshatched Poison Ring
description: A heavy silver signet ring with an intricate crosshatched engraving. The top hinges open to reveal a tiny hidden compartment.
interactiveProperties: Can be worn as a cosmetic accessory or used to store 1 dose of powdered potion for quick tactical use.
basedOn: Victorian secret poison rings in Gorey's murder mystery aesthetic

name: Woven Golden Willow Throne
description: A high-backed throne woven entirely from living golden willow branches that blossom with fragrant white flowers when sat upon.
interactiveProperties: Sitting here grants 'Fae Grace' (+10% movement speed and jump height). The throne gently sways as if caressed by a summer breeze.
basedOn: Alan Lee's watercolor ethereal wooden architecture and fae thrones

name: Sunlit Gossamer Daybed
description: A low, elegant daybed framed in carved ash wood and draped with translucent gossamer fabric that catches golden forest light.
interactiveProperties: Resting here rapidly restores player health and clears all fatigue debuffs while surrounding the player in golden particle light.
basedOn: Alan Lee's romantic, soft watercolor interiors

name: Riddle-Inscribed Sundial Table
description: A round quartz table etched with delicate Elvish riddles. A golden brass needle casts shadows that point to hidden runes.
interactiveProperties: Players rotate the needle to solve sun-riddles based on current game time. Correct answers unlock secret Seelie treasure caches.
basedOn: Alan Lee's ancient stone dials and fae riddlelore

name: Gossamer & Birch Wood Harp
description: A graceful standing harp constructed from curved silver birch wood, strung with luminous gossamer threads that chime without touching.
interactiveProperties: Players can play melodies on the harp. Playing the 'Summer Carol' causes surrounding flora to bloom instantly and open secret vine gates.
basedOn: Alan Lee's depictions of elven musical instruments

name: Golden Summer Solstice Crown
description: A circlet woven from threads of pure golden light and preserved solstice leaves that never wither.
interactiveProperties: Required by the Seelie Ambassador to complete the Summer Court Alliance quest line. Grants water-walking when equipped.
basedOn: The Seelie Queen's regalia in Alan Lee's faerie illustrations

name: Dewdrop Crystal Lantern of Truth
description: A crystal lantern containing a single magnified drop of morning dew that glows with an unwavering warm golden light.
interactiveProperties: Dispel illusions, revealing hidden Seelie pathways and unmasking shapeshifted Unseelie spies in the zone.
basedOn: Fae magic light sources in watercolor legendry

name: Golden Oak Tuning Fork
description: A carved wooden tuning fork that vibrates at the natural frequency of growing plants and trees.
interactiveProperties: Equippable tool used to commune with ancient forest trees, unlocking hidden dialogue and harvesting rare sap.
basedOn: Subtle natural sound tools in elven lore

name: Prismatic Dewdrop Gem
description: A gemstone formed from a single drop of Seelie dawn dew, permanently frozen into a brilliant sun-catching crystal.
interactiveProperties: Can be placed on pedestals to project tiny rainbows across the room or traded for high-tier Seelie enchantments.
basedOn: Magical dew drops solidified into jewels in fae mythology

name: Frost-Forged Shadow Stone Throne
description: A massive dark granite seat wrapped in layers of creeping frost and shadow ice. It radiates an ominous, icy authority.
interactiveProperties: Sitting grants 'Frost Monarch' (+20% ice damage and resistance to freezing). Non-Unseelie NPCs bow when you sit here.
basedOn: John Bauer's massive Scandinavian troll thrones carved from mossy boulders

name: Glacial Ice Table of the Winter King
description: A thick slab of dark blue shadow ice supported by rough mossy stone monoliths. The surface never melts, even near flame.
interactiveProperties: Items placed on the table freeze instantly, preserving food and reagents indefinitely without decay.
basedOn: Bauer's dark fairytale banquet tables in deep Scandinavian forests

name: Troll-Carved Rune Monolith
description: A towering ancient stone monolith etched with deep Scandinavian troll runes that pulse with cold blue luminescence.
interactiveProperties: Players touch the runes to channel winter frost magic. Solving the rune alignment puzzle summons a temporary Shadow Ice Guard.
basedOn: John Bauer's iconic mossy boulders and giant troll stone carvings

name: Shadow-Ice Anvil of the Anvilmaster
description: A heavy anvil forged from black iron resting on a pedestal of unmelting shadow ice. Used to craft dark winter armament.
interactiveProperties: Primary crafting station for Unseelie weapons and frost-forged armor. Striking the anvil emits a spray of freezing blue sparks.
basedOn: Scandinavian dark fairytale blacksmithing and troll craftsmanship

name: Shadow-Ice Heart Core
description: A jagged, pulsing crystal of pure shadow ice that freezes the air around it into delicate ice needles.
interactiveProperties: Required to break the Frost Curse over the Unseelie Vault and forge the Glacial Broadsword.
basedOn: The icy heart of the troll king in Bauer's dark folklore

name: Troll King's Bone & Iron Crown
description: A heavy, sprawling crown crafted from jagged dark iron and carved troll horn bone, set with raw shadow sapphires.
interactiveProperties: Equipped or delivered to the Winter Regent to claim lordship over the Unseelie territory. Unlocks dark combat trials.
basedOn: John Bauer's oversized ornate troll crowns in Among Goblins and Trolls

name: Frost-Forged Iron Warhorn
description: A heavy iron hunting horn wrapped in frost-coated leather, producing a deep, terrifying blast when sounded.
interactiveProperties: Equippable tool used to blow a blizzard call that freezes nearby enemies for 3 seconds and clears shadow fog.
basedOn: Scandinavian hunting horns in dark fairytale illustrations

name: Glacial Ice Runestone
description: A palm-sized fragment of dark glacial ice etched with protection runes that fill with shimmering silver powder.
interactiveProperties: Can be set into weapon sockets for ice damage or displayed on pedestals as a frost trophy.
basedOn: John Bauer's magical runestones hidden in deep pine forests

name: Abyssal Obsidian & Coral Altar
description: A dark, sleek altar sculpted from polished black obsidian, wrapped in living red coral that pulses with deep sea light.
interactiveProperties: Functions as an oceanic ritual station. Placing marine artifacts on the altar imbues them with 'Abyssal Resonance'.
basedOn: Luis Royo's dark fantasy aquatic art and sensuous organic stone shapes

name: Iridescent Pearl Shell Lounge
description: A luxurious reclining lounge set inside a massive polished giant clam shell, lined with iridescent mother-of-pearl and dark silk kelp.
interactiveProperties: Seats 2 players. Resting here grants underwater breathing and underwater vision for 30 minutes.
basedOn: Royo's dark sensuous aquatic thrones and pearl resting beds

name: Tide-Calling Conch Organ
description: A monumental aquatic organ constructed from giant spiraled sea shells and coral pipes that channel water pressure into deep oceanic notes.
interactiveProperties: Players play hydraulic keys to alter water current direction and drain flooded chambers in the Atlantis ruins.
basedOn: Royo's biomechanical and organic musical creations

name: Bioluminescent Deep Sea Basin
description: A wide basalt basin filled with pitch-black oceanic water illuminated from within by floating bioluminescent plankton.
interactiveProperties: Players can peer into the basin to scry distant flooded rooms, revealing enemy locations and submerged chest locations.
basedOn: Royo's dark glowing water pools and scrying basins

name: Leviathan Scale Heartstone
description: A hand-sized dragon scale from an ancient abyss leviathan, hard as diamond and shimmering with deep oceanic teal light.
interactiveProperties: Required to power the Abyssal Engine and unlock the lowest gates of the Atlantis Trench.
basedOn: Royo's dark aquatic dragons and sea serpent motifs

name: Golden Trident of the Tide Sovereign
description: A majestic three-pronged trident forged from gleaming Orichalcum, set with a glowing pearl core at its center.
interactiveProperties: Required to seal the deep-sea abyssal rift during the climax of the Atlantis quest line. Can be mounted as a trophy after.
basedOn: Royo's dark fantasy royal weaponry

name: Coral Carving Glass Needle
description: A needle-sharp instrument made from volcanic sea glass, used to engrave living coral without harming its growth.
interactiveProperties: Equippable tool used to harvest delicate bioluminescent coral branches and sculpt marine furniture.
basedOn: Precision aquatic tools in Atlantean artisan craft

name: Tear of the Sea Siren
description: A teardrop-shaped pearl that glows with an intense sapphire light, capturing the motion of ocean waves within its core.
interactiveProperties: Can be placed on display stands or traded to the Sea Collector for legendary Atlantean armor blueprints.
basedOn: Royo's sensuous siren mythology and dark ocean gems

name: Red Mesa Shrine Altar
description: A low-standing ceremonial altar cut directly from red sandstone strata, featuring turquoise channels that guide rain runoff into carved basin symbols.
interactiveProperties: Placing a sun-warmed mineral specimen on the altar surface aligns sunlight reflections across canyon wall glyphs, unlocking ancient plateau maps.
basedOn: Maynard Dixon's geometric red rock monoliths and Southwestern architectural shrines

name: Juniper-Carved Archive Bench
description: A rugged bench crafted from twisted high-desert juniper wood, bound with rawhide straps and polished with natural beeswax.
interactiveProperties: Players resting on this bench gain the 'Canyon Watcher' buff, reducing stamina depletion while climbing high sandstone cliffs.
basedOn: Maynard Dixon's rugged wooden ranch and wilderness furniture designs

name: Turquoise Sun Disc
description: An ancient circular plate of polished Sleeping Beauty turquoise surrounded by a radiant copper sunburst housing.
interactiveProperties: Fits into the Solstice Aperture inside the Echo Canyon Vault to trigger light beam puzzles.
basedOn: Maynard Dixon's bold Southwestern motifs and traditional sky-god stone icons

name: Petroglyph Cipher Slab
description: A weathered tablet of dark desert varnish sandstone etched with horn-headed figures, spiral star paths, and canyon trail marks.
interactiveProperties: Decipherable using a Geologist's Lens; reveals hidden coordinates to secret turquoise veins across the plateau.
basedOn: Maynard Dixon's stark canvas compositions of ancient indigenous rock art in Zion and Bryce

name: High-Desert Geode Pick
description: A compact prospector pick with an angular tempered steel head and an ergonomically carved juniper wood handle.
interactiveProperties: Harvests raw turquoise veins and red quartz nodules without fracturing delicate inner crystal structures.
basedOn: Maynard Dixon's rugged trail prospector gear with high-contrast iron forge details

name: Juniper Pitch Resin Pot
description: A heavy terracotta kiln pot filled with smoldering juniper sap used for waterproofing leather and crafting sticky adhesives.
interactiveProperties: Heats raw tree resin over a campfire to create flexible sealing coats for timber furniture and earthenware containers.
basedOn: Maynard Dixon's warm desert campfires and traditional Southwestern pottery cauldrons

name: Canyon Echo Basin
description: A natural stone bowl carved out of red sandstone, filled with pristine rainwater that echoes subtle acoustic vibrations.
interactiveProperties: Playing wind instruments near the basin creates standing waves that highlight sub-surface mineral pulse directions.
basedOn: Maynard Dixon's dramatic canyon shadows and natural stone basin reflections

name: Desert Varnish Agate Nodules
description: Rough mineral geodes covered in a lustrous black iron-manganese patina formed over thousands of desert years.
interactiveProperties: Can be split open on a lapidary bench to reveal vibrant orange carnelian or displayed in archive cabinets.
basedOn: Maynard Dixon's sharp, sun-baked desert soil studies and mineral rock specimens

name: Lodgepole Pine Thermal Cabinet
description: A tall rustic cabinet built from peeled lodgepole pine timbers, equipped with lower vents that capture geothermal steam.
interactiveProperties: Uses thermal vent steam to rapidly dry rare botanical specimens and cure parchment maps without scorching.
basedOn: Thomas Hart Benton's undulating rustic timber furniture and regionalist wilderness lodge aesthetics

name: Sinter Stone Display Pedestal
description: A terraced display pedestal formed from white siliceous sinter deposited by active mineral hot springs.
interactiveProperties: Items displayed on this pedestal emit a soft bioluminescent aura sustained by heat-loving microbial cultures.
basedOn: Thomas Hart Benton's dynamic, flowing mineral formations and hot spring terracing

name: Obsidian Mirror Glyph
description: A curved disc of jet-black volcanic glass mounted in a scorched lodgepole frame, reflecting heat patterns as vivid light.
interactiveProperties: Reveals invisible thermal convection paths when pointed toward steaming mud pots and geyser vents.
basedOn: Thomas Hart Benton's high-contrast dark curves and regionalist volcanic folklore

name: Thermophile Prism Core
description: A crystalline specimen formed from concentric bands of thermophilic bacteria encrusted in translucent silica sinter.
interactiveProperties: Required to calibrate the Inn's Geothermal Boiler Engine and stabilize thermal spring temperatures.
basedOn: Thomas Hart Benton's vibrant, swirling color bands inspired by Grand Prismatic Spring

name: Geyser Thermal Sampler
description: A heavy brass sampling flask mounted on an insulated lodgepole extension rod for extracting scalding geothermal fluids.
interactiveProperties: Safely harvests boiling hot spring mineral water and sulfur steam samples without burning the user.
basedOn: Thomas Hart Benton's sinuous metalwork and early national park scientific survey gear

name: Subterranean Geyser Vent Valve
description: A heavy cast-iron wheel mechanism fitted over a basalt pipe collar, controlling deep steam release in geyser fields.
interactiveProperties: Turning the wheel redirects steam pressure across thermal basins, clearing fogged paths or activating steam lifts.
basedOn: Thomas Hart Benton's energetic industrial-meets-nature muscular structural motifs

name: Boiling Mud Pot Cauldron
description: A naturally bubbling clay pit enclosed in basalt masonry, filled with mineral-rich thermal mud.
interactiveProperties: Allows crafting players to temper metal tools or dye fabrics in deep ochre and slate grey geothermal pigments.
basedOn: Thomas Hart Benton's swirling, rhythmic bubbling mud pools and earth tones

name: Sheared Obsidian Arrowhead Cluster
description: A collection of expertly knapped volcanic glass blades bound together with dried sinew and pine resin.
interactiveProperties: Valuable volcanic trade specimen that grants a bonus to precision tool crafting when kept in a workshop drawer.
basedOn: Thomas Hart Benton's sharp rhythmic contouring and ancient trade artifact depictions

name: Ironwood Prospector Table
description: A massive, extremely heavy workstation cut from dense desert ironwood, reinforced with hand-hammered brass corner plates.
interactiveProperties: Provides an sturdy assaying surface for weighing ore samples and drafting mine shaft blueprints.
basedOn: Albert Bierstadt's heroic frontier lodge interiors and heavy desert timbers

name: Granite & Gold Assay Shelf
description: A heavy wall shelf carved from porphyritic granite, featuring velvet-lined grooves for storing gold bars and ore specimens.
interactiveProperties: Stores heavy metal ingots, automatically organizing them by mineral density and purity level.
basedOn: Albert Bierstadt's dramatic mountain stone architecture and romantic western lighting

name: Peralta Gold Mine Keycard Matrix
description: An intricate locking plate composed of raw gold nuggets embedded into carved ironwood with quartz alignment pins.
interactiveProperties: Unlocks the heavy timber gate leading to the lower Peralta gold vein inside Weaver's Needle.
basedOn: Albert Bierstadt's legendary lost treasure motifs and dramatic mountain mystery

name: Lost Dutchman's Compass
description: A brass pocket compass housing a natural lodestone needle that swings toward underground magnetic quartz veins.
interactiveProperties: Points directly toward hidden granite fissures and gold veins during golden hour lighting conditions.
basedOn: Albert Bierstadt's atmospheric light shafts and romanticized frontier exploration

name: Ironwood Mine Sledge pick
description: A heavy prospector pick featuring a dense ironwood shaft and a hardened high-carbon steel head for breaking granite.
interactiveProperties: Capable of breaking dense granite rock faces to expose quartz stringers and raw gold deposits.
basedOn: Albert Bierstadt's rugged pioneer gear rendered with sharp lighting highlights

name: Granite Sluice Box System
description: A tiered water trough carved from granite blocks and fitted with ironwood riffles for separating placer gold from river gravel.
interactiveProperties: Pours river water over mined gravel to extract fine gold dust, garnets, and heavy black sand.
basedOn: Albert Bierstadt's sweeping mountain streams and gold rush engineering

name: Golden Hour Sun-Dial Pillar
description: A tall granite column topped with a brass gnomon that aligns with Weaver's Needle during late afternoon sunlight.
interactiveProperties: When sunset rays hit the brass gnomon, a reflected light beam illuminates the concealed entrance to the lost shaft.
basedOn: Albert Bierstadt's iconic golden light rays breaking over steep mountain crags

name: Raw Gold-in-Quartz Cluster
description: A striking rock specimen consisting of bright yellow wire gold branching through milky quartz matrix.
interactiveProperties: Highly prized display specimen that increases gold crafting efficiency when placed near an anvil.
basedOn: Albert Bierstadt's hyper-detailed mineral textures and glowing mountain veins

name: Wormy Chestnut Herbalist Desk
description: A rustic study desk made from reclaimed wormy chestnut timber, with hand-dovetailed drawers and a beeswax rubbing.
interactiveProperties: Drawers are climate-buffered for slow-curing delicate forest herbs and mountain ginseng without decay.
basedOn: Andrew Wyeth's weathered interior furniture and muted farmstead realism

name: Sugar Maple Drying Rack
description: A freestanding ladder-style drying frame constructed from hard sugar maple poles and natural hemp twine.
interactiveProperties: Hanging harvested flora and fungi here accelerates their drying and processing time by 50%.
basedOn: Andrew Wyeth's stark simplicity and textured wooden structures in rural Maine and Pennsylvania

name: Wild Ginseng Fork Root
description: A prized, multi-forked wild ginseng root harvested from moist Appalachian ridge loam, wrapped in damp moss.
interactiveProperties: Turned in to the Ridge Herbalist to complete the 'Seven Decades Root' questline and unlock potent restorative elixirs.
basedOn: Andrew Wyeth's subtle botanical fidelity and quiet woodsman folklore

name: Misty Mountain Ridge Map
description: A hand-drawn map on unbleached linen paper using sepia tempera ink, illustrating subtle ridge paths through dense mountain fog.
interactiveProperties: Guides players safely through the impenetrable fog of High Knob Gap without losing trail markers.
basedOn: Andrew Wyeth's monochrome egg tempera tones depicting fog-shrouded Appalachian hills

name: Chestnut Digging Mattock
description: A lightweight woodsman's tool featuring a forged steel adze blade fixed to a gracefully curved chestnut handle.
interactiveProperties: Extracts delicate roots, truffles, and clay deposits intact without damaging surrounding plant ecology.
basedOn: Andrew Wyeth's utilitarian farm implements rendered with honest, worn craftsmanship

name: Maple Syrup Evaporator Pan
description: A long, flat copper evaporation pan mounted over a brick fire arch, designed for reducing sugar maple sap.
interactiveProperties: Boils collected maple sap down into dark amber syrup used for cooking high-stamina trail rations.
basedOn: Andrew Wyeth's quiet autumn sugarhouse interiors and steaming brass kettles

name: Fog-Catcher Linen Screen
description: A tall wooden frame stringing translucent unbleached linen fabric that condenses passing mountain drizzle into a collection trough.
interactiveProperties: Harvests pure dew and mountain mist water overnight, filling water flasks automatically.
basedOn: Andrew Wyeth's breezy curtains and translucent open windows blowing in misty air

name: Appalachian Lichen & Moss Press
description: A wooden herbarium press containing dried specimens of reindeer lichen, tree lungwort, and clubmoss.
interactiveProperties: Unlocks muted natural dye colors (slate grey, dried olive, ochre) at the Inn's textile loom.
basedOn: Andrew Wyeth's subtle earthy color palette and detailed botanical studies

name: Petrified Wood Slab Table
description: A heavy coffee table formed from a polished cross-cut section of petrified tree trunk resting on matte black steel legs.
interactiveProperties: Indestructible stone surface. Reagents or tools placed on this surface are protected from chemical corrosion.
basedOn: Ansel Adams' intense tonal contrast and sharp focus on ancient geological formations

name: Chalcedony Fossil Cabinet
description: An archival display case framed in petrified timber with sliding translucent chalcedony glass doors.
interactiveProperties: Locks delicate fossilized seeds in stasis, preserving their structural integrity permanently.
basedOn: Ansel Adams' precise archival museum framing and crisp monochromatic shadow play

name: Triassic Fern Fossil Tile
description: A square slab of silicified mudstone bearing a razor-sharp black carbonized imprint of an ancient fern frond.
interactiveProperties: Inserts into the Stratum Keyhole in the Badlands Archive to open the deep Triassic vault.
basedOn: Ansel Adams' famous macro prints of delicate natural textures etched in rock

name: Agate Gem-Core Key
description: A cylindrical key ground from banded carnelian agate with silver wire gears mounted on the base.
interactiveProperties: Turns the mineral tumbler lock inside the Petrified Vault, exposing ancient fossilized tree ring logs.
basedOn: Ansel Adams' luminous highlights on desert mineral surfaces

name: Chalcedony Saw & Lapidary Blade
description: A precision hand saw fitted with a diamond-grit cutting edge and a comfortable petrified wood handle.
interactiveProperties: Cuts raw petrified logs, chalcedony nodules, and fossil slabs into smooth building tiles.
basedOn: Ansel Adams' high-precision observational aesthetic and sharp-edged mineral tools

name: Petrified Log Lapidary Polisher
description: A foot-treadle grinding wheel turned from a heavy cylinder of petrified wood, fed by an overhead water drip.
interactiveProperties: Grinds and polishes rough geodes, transforming unpolished stones into valuable gemstone collectibles.
basedOn: Ansel Adams' stark contrast between raw rough rock faces and glass-smooth polished surfaces

name: Monolith Shadow Gnomon
description: A tall petrified tree trunk column set in an etched stone circle, casting high-contrast shadows across the ground.
interactiveProperties: Casts sharp black shadows that align with geological fracture lines, revealing hidden mineral deposits at solar noon.
basedOn: Ansel Adams' dramatic play of deep shadows and brilliant Zone V highlights across rock monoliths

name: Banded Chalcedony Geode Half
description: A halved geode displaying dramatic concentric rings of jet black, stark white, and deep grey microcrystalline quartz.
interactiveProperties: Exhibits maximum monochromatic contrast; increases geological study output when placed in the library.
basedOn: Ansel Adams' brilliant Zone System contrast from deep blacks to pure crystalline whites

name: Redwood Burl Archivist Throne
description: A grand armchair hollowed out from a massive redwood burl, cushioned with living green moss and sword ferns.
interactiveProperties: Sitting on the throne grants high-canopy vision, revealing real-time fog movements and hidden paths.
basedOn: Emily Carr's expressive, living redwood tree trunks and totemic forest forms

name: Fern-Woven Canopy Hammock
description: A broad hammock woven from durable deer fern fibers and suspended between redwood heartwood struts.
interactiveProperties: Suspended high in the trees; sleeping here fully restores stamina and cures damp chill effects.
basedOn: Emily Carr's sweeping green curves and organic forest canopy rhythm

name: Heart of the Ancient Redwood Seedling
description: A golden cone from an ancient old-growth tree nestled in rich forest humus inside a carved cedar bowl.
interactiveProperties: Planted at Cathedral Grove to complete the 'Cycle of the Giants' quest and sprout a permanent vine ladder.
basedOn: Emily Carr's spiritual reverence for sacred old-growth trees and living wilderness

name: Fog-Weaver's Carved Totem Mask
description: A ceremonial mask carved from redwood heartwood with abalone shell eye inlays and fern spore paint accents.
interactiveProperties: Equipping the mask allows safe navigation through dense fog walls into the restricted Deep Growth grove.
basedOn: Emily Carr's dynamic integration of Pacific Northwest indigenous carving and swirling mist

name: Redwood Bark Adze
description: A curved woodworking adze with a hand-forged blade lashed securely to an ergonomic redwood root handle.
interactiveProperties: Strips thick fibrous redwood bark cleanly without damaging the underlying structural heartwood.
basedOn: Emily Carr's bold, rhythmic carved woodwork textures and organic hand tools

name: Sword Fern Spore Condenser
description: A hollowed redwood log vessel fitted with brass wire condensation screens and fresh fern frond lining.
interactiveProperties: Extracts bioluminescent fog dew and green fern spores for brewing agility and stealth elixirs.
basedOn: Emily Carr's lush, vibrant green understory and misty forest atmosphere

name: Hollow Redwood Resonance Drum
description: A massive standing drum fashioned from a hollowed lightning-struck redwood trunk covered in tight elk hide.
interactiveProperties: Striking the drum produces a deep sonic pulse that clears coastal fog patches within a wide radius.
basedOn: Emily Carr's rhythmic, pulsing forest acoustics and totemic forms

name: Conk Mushroom Shelf Specimen
description: A large, woody artist's conk bracket mushroom preserved with natural spruce tree resin.
interactiveProperties: Can be etched with fine needles like natural slate or mounted on cabin walls as organic shelving.
basedOn: Emily Carr's rich textural details on decaying and living ancient trunks

name: Sea Glass & Driftwood Table
description: A low coastal table made of ocean-smoothed driftwood inlaid with a glowing mosaic of cobalt and emerald sea glass.
interactiveProperties: Refracts ambient cavern light onto surrounding rock walls, revealing hidden aquatic maps.
basedOn: Norman Lewis' ethereal, atmospheric light layers and translucent coastal shapes

name: Salt Crystal Basalt Basin
description: A pedestal basin chiseled from columnar basalt, encrusted with shimmering pink and white halite salt crystals.
interactiveProperties: Evaporates seawater left inside, producing pure mineral salt flakes and rare sea pearls.
basedOn: Norman Lewis' rhythmic, crystalline line structures and dark ocean depths

name: Perfect Tidal Cave Pearl
description: A luminous, spherical cave pearl formed over centuries by dripping calcium-saturated water in sea spray grottos.
interactiveProperties: Placed into the Altar of the Tide to calm turbulent water surges and reveal submerged cavern tunnels.
basedOn: Norman Lewis' radiant central glowing foci amidst dark atmospheric wash

name: Sea Glass Prism Sextant
description: A maritime navigation instrument crafted from tarnished brass and fitted with frosted sea glass prisms.
interactiveProperties: Aligns moonlit tidal reflections to locate flooded shipwreck vaults along the cavern coast.
basedOn: Norman Lewis' abstract geometric calligraphic lines and maritime themes

name: Salt Crystal Chisel
description: A delicate bronze hand chisel designed with a padded sea glass handle for delicate mineral extraction.
interactiveProperties: Safely prised fragile cave pearls and delicate salt crystal formations from cave walls without shattering them.
basedOn: Norman Lewis' delicate scratch lines and textured calligraphic marks

name: Tidal Pool Resonating Pool
description: A natural stone tide basin filled with clear seawater and teeming with glowing bioluminescent dinoflagellates.
interactiveProperties: Disturbing the water sends glowing blue light ripples across the floor, highlighting secret submerged crawlspaces.
basedOn: Norman Lewis' luminous, layered watery fields of color and subtle motion

name: Salt Crust Desalination Still
description: A terracotta dome distillation setup connected to a copper coil, heated over hot basalt coals.
interactiveProperties: Converts ocean saltwater into fresh drinking water while collecting purified sea salt crystals in the tray.
basedOn: Norman Lewis' organic fluid lines interacting with sharp linear grids

name: Frosted Cobalt Sea Glass Cluster
description: A collection of ocean-tumbled cobalt blue glass fragments with a soft, frosted salt patina.
interactiveProperties: Can be crushed on a grinding stone to produce rich lapis-like blue pigments for painting or craft dyeing.
basedOn: Norman Lewis' translucent color field layering and light diffusion

name: Levitating Green Apple Fountain
description: A tiered marble garden basin over which a oversized green jade apple floats silently in mid-air, spouting clean water.
interactiveProperties: Water flows upward from the basin into the floating apple; drinking restores stamina and grants brief levitation.
basedOn: René Magritte's iconic levitating green apples combined with Henri Rousseau's lush garden basins

name: Bowler Hat Garden Planter
description: A bronze sculpture shaped like a classic gentleman's bowler hat, spilling over with lush tropical monstera leaves.
interactiveProperties: Flora planted inside this surreal planter grows double-sized and yields paradoxical hybrid fruits.
basedOn: René Magritte's signature bowler hat motif combined with Henri Rousseau's wild jungle flora

name: Key of the Impossible Door
description: An ornate iron key whose skeleton bit is shaped like a cloud silhouette, cold to the touch regardless of temperature.
