interactiveProperties: Unlocks freestanding wooden doorframes in the garden that step directly into different climate zones.
basedOn: René Magritte's paradoxical freestanding doors and Henri Rousseau's mysterious garden vistas

name: Surreal Moon-in-a-Cage Lamp
description: A wrought-iron birdcage hanging from a garden arch, housing a glowing spherical miniature moon.
interactiveProperties: Casts bright noon sunlight within a ten-foot radius even during midnight garden exploration.
basedOn: René Magritte's nighttime streetlights under daytime skies and Henri Rousseau's luminous full moons

name: Jungle Pruning Shears of Paradox
description: Polished steel shears with ivory handles that cut thick vines effortlessly while releasing paper butterflies.
interactiveProperties: Clears overgrown jungle thickets instantly; severed leaves magically transform into collectable paper butterflies.
basedOn: Henri Rousseau's crisp leaf outlines and René Magritte's impossible metal tools

name: Freestanding Sky Frame Mirror
description: A heavy gilded mirror frame standing alone on the lawn, reflecting an open blue sky regardless of weather.
interactiveProperties: Stepping through the mirror frame teleports the player to the opposite side of the Inn's expansive gardens.
basedOn: René Magritte's framed sky mirrors standing amidst dense natural landscapes

name: Tiger-in-a-Tropical-Storm Wind Vane
description: A weather vane featuring a brass prowling tiger silhouette that spins wildly even on windless days.
interactiveProperties: Manually spinning the vane alters local weather conditions between tropical rainstorms and calm sunlight.
basedOn: Henri Rousseau's masterpiece 'Surprised! (Tiger in a Tropical Storm)' and Magritte's weather paradoxes

name: Ceci N'est Pas Une Pipe Carving
description: A polished briarwood tobacco pipe sculpture resting on a wooden plinth inscribed with surreal French text.
interactiveProperties: Enigmatic display object that boosts passive lore perception when placed in the Inn's central hallway.
basedOn: René Magritte's 'The Treachery of Images' combined with Henri Rousseau's exotic wood craft

name: Onion-Domed Amber Shrine Cabinet
description: A tall cabinet crafted from silver birch wood, topped with a gilded onion dome and inlaid with glowing Baltic amber.
interactiveProperties: Stores sacred relics; internal amber panels radiate warmth that prevents stored liquids from freezing.
basedOn: Nicholas Roerich's sacred mountain architecture and glowing onion domes

name: Carved Birch Boreal Workbench
description: A sturdy carpentry workbench made of white birch wood, carved with traditional Slavic solar motifs and folk knotwork.
interactiveProperties: Provides a craft bonus when carving wooden talismans, sacred icons, and amber incense burners.
basedOn: Nicholas Roerich's vibrant folk timber craft and high-altitude monastic retreats

name: Glowing Baltic Amber Sun Stone
description: A large translucent lump of golden Baltic amber enclosing an ancient pine needle, bound in braided gold wire.
interactiveProperties: Placed atop the Boreal Shrine to radiate heat and melt glacial ice seals over the monastery archives.
basedOn: Nicholas Roerich's luminous, spiritual color palettes and sacred light motifs

name: Firebird Feather Talisman
description: A feather-shaped talisman carved from glowing amber and wrapped in golden thread and birch bark strips.
interactiveProperties: Used to summon the Boreal Guardian Spirit and illuminate hidden paths through mountain blizzards.
basedOn: Nicholas Roerich's vivid blue and gold Slavic folklore paintings

name: Birch Bark Tapping Spout
description: A carved bone spout with a folded birch bark bucket for harvesting aromatic sap from boreal trees.
interactiveProperties: Taps silver birch trunks in early spring to collect sweet sap and pine resin for crafting adhesives.
basedOn: Nicholas Roerich's traditional boreal forest wilderness tools and folk craftsmanship

name: Sacred Mountain Icon Brazier
description: A bronze tripod brazier carved with mountain glyphs, burning aromatic amber resin and birch charcoal.
interactiveProperties: Burning amber resin creates a protective radiant warmth zone that repels frost spirits during night storms.
basedOn: Nicholas Roerich's glowing mountain fires, intense skies, and spiritual sanctuaries

name: Boreal Chime Wind Carillon
description: A set of tuned hollow birch chimes suspended with raw amber beads that ring musically in mountain breezes.
interactiveProperties: Playing the carillon sends harmonic acoustic pulses across the valley, calming severe blizzards.
basedOn: Nicholas Roerich's majestic, quiet mountain atmosphere and traditional Russian wooden chimes

name: Raw Baltic Amber Nugget with Prehistoric Inclusion
description: A polished lump of clear honey amber preserving an intact prehistoric botanical fragment.
interactiveProperties: Rare ancient fossil resin that unlocks advanced alchemy and wood preservative recipes in the archive.
basedOn: Nicholas Roerich's deep saturated gem tones and ancient Earth history focus
